description: This file contains service functions for managing AI assistants, including creation, deletion, retrieval, updating, importing, and auxiliary functions like fetching models, document stores, tools, and generating instructions. It interacts with external APIs (OpenAI), database entities, and project utilities.

methods.name: createAssistant
methods.description: Creates a new assistant, either custom or based on external API (OpenAI), handling credential decryption, tool setup, and database insertion.

methods.name: deleteAssistant
methods.description: Deletes an assistant by ID, optionally removing associated OpenAI assistant if not custom, handling credential decryption.

methods.name: getAssistantsCountByOrganization
methods.description: Counts assistants of a specific type within an organization by aggregating workspace data.

methods.name: getAllAssistants
methods.description: Retrieves all assistants for a workspace, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getAllAssistantsCount
methods.description: Counts all assistants within a workspace, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getAssistantById
methods.description: Fetches a specific assistant by ID within a workspace.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates assistant details, including interaction with OpenAI API for non-custom assistants, handling credential decryption and tool management.

methods.name: importAssistants
methods.description: Bulk imports assistants, checking for duplicates and usage limits, inserting new records into the database.

methods.name: getChatModels
methods.description: Fetches available chat models from nodes service, filtering out specific tags.

methods.name: getDocumentStores
methods.description: Retrieves document stores for a workspace with status 'UPSERTED'.

methods.name: getTools
methods.description: Fetches tools and filters them based on input parameter types.

methods.name: generateAssistantInstruction
methods.description: Generates instructions for an assistant based on a task and selected chat model, dynamically importing node modules and invoking them.
